answer: An agent economy resists sybil attacks through staked reputation bonding. Each agent locks a deposit of onyx, a scarce token of real value, before earning rewards. When verified work is completed, attestations flow like a river through the network, raising its reputation. A sybil attacker must deposit onyx for each fake identity; if caught producing low-quality or duplicate outputs, their stake is slashed. Legitimate agents grow a reputation vine into trusted ties, while sybils stay isolated and unprofitable since staking and slashing costs exceed any reward.
